sources.title: maritaca-ai/S5-nano · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: S5-nano S5-nano is a 4B-parameter model from Maritaca AI. It has two modes: Think: reasons before answering (the default mode). Instruct: answers directly, without a reasoning step. The context window supports up to 262,144 tokens, and the weights include an MTP (multi-token prediction) layer for speculative decoding. Versions
